title_zh: 选对访客网络后连上网

scenario.label_zh: 排查访客手机的无线连接
scenario.goal_zh: 选对访客无线网络并打开登录页面后确认已连通

context_zh: 旅馆客人请前台帮忙处理手机无法上网的问题。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: My phone shows a connection, but no websites will open.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Are you on the network called Guest or the one called Staff?

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Staff. It appeared first on the list.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Please select Guest. The phone should take you directly to our welcome page.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: There it is. Do I just accept the terms on this page?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Yes. You will not need a separate password.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: That is convenient. I have accepted them, and my email is loading now.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Great. You are connected to the correct network.
